description: Editable first-pass assembly abstraction; raw UART operations, not a completed transport.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Three raw TX writes and one RX read. No ACK validation, TX polling or offline-safe boot guarantee.

methods.name: Send
outputs: DR1: raw UART STATUS, or -1 for unsupported count
methods.description: Single-payload raw write body. Multiword Send NOT IMPLEMENTED. STATUS is not delivery acknowledgement.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Hint write and three RX reads. Field names reflect recovered intent; framing, blocking and timeout NOT IMPLEMENTED.

methods.name: Fault
methods.description: Six raw TX writes. No priority bypass or transmission guarantee.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Request writes/read only. Installation, stream receive, size validation and CRC NOT IMPLEMENTED.

methods.name: Call
methods.description: No I/O or capability invocation. Real remote Call handshake NOT IMPLEMENTED.

abi_notes: DR0 is immutable zero; DR1 is the primary result.
CR7 is UART scratch. Modern RETURN uses the implicit continuation and clears working CRs by its default mask.
Raw UART accesses do not implement a functional host protocol.
Local -1 NOT_IMPLEMENTED results are not transmitted on the wire.
No published binary, Namespace binding for Tunnel, or privileged grant is created.
